details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: seen once, in the first nightly after the change merged. The last pass was the Nov 17 21:09 rocm720 nightly on [`1aa45c66`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/1aa45c661758b2ff99dc8c57ec849175ab4625ed).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#51000](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/51000) ([`ea93e2fc`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/ea93e2fcd0d1566f4817c0fe8ddfe6d8006908fd)) sets `SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=never` for Kimi-K3.1 on gfx950. CI imports sglang from an editable checkout that has no bundled TreeCore. Any rank whose `cargo` probe succeeds picks Rust, and in `never` mode that rank crashes. **Disconfirming**: it is not proven why `cargo` succeeded on every rank. A rustup install on first use is likely (see [#46823](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46823)).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. [#46823](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46823) and [#44522](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44522) are related, but neither one fixes this.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: run the job by hand with `SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=auto`. If it passes, fall back to the Python TreeCore when the mode is `never` and the module is not bundled.

details.label: Status

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]` the AMD index's `triton-kernels` page sometimes leaves out the pinned wheel, so pip sees only PyPI's `0.1.0`.
